result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The most noticeable problem is a dark horizontal bar overlaying the bottom navigation, which makes the nav look broken. There are also minor edge-clipping artifacts from horizontally scrollable content.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar is overlaying the bottom navigation area, crossing through the search and middle navigation icons. This makes the tab bar look visually broken and may interfere with icon recognition or tapping.
issues.suggestion: Remove the overlaying bar or reposition it below the navigation area. If it is intended to be a gesture/home indicator, place it at the very bottom with proper spacing and styling.

issues.description: Horizontally scrollable rows show partially clipped items at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” While this can indicate scrollability, the clipping looks a bit abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent carousel padding, ensure partially visible cards are intentionally cropped, or use a subtle fade/scroll affordance to make horizontal scrolling feel deliberate.
